caption: The drawing features a single piece of furniture, specifically a small wooden table or nightstand, positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The table is colored in various shades of reddish-brown, suggesting a wood material, and has a smooth finish. The table has a rectangular top with slightly curved edges; its front face displays two distinct horizontal sections—a drawer at the top with a small round knob and a solid panel below. The sides and legs of the table are depicted in darker hues to give the object depth and dimension. The legs are straight but arch inward at the bottom. There is no other object, design, or label present in the background, which remains unornamented and neutral in tone.
